trajectory_summary: The call is warm and cooperative throughout — the customer does much of the relationship-building work herself, volunteering personal context, humor, and eventually a workaround for the bill photo. But the rep never converts the rich material she offers (widowhood, fixed income, despised-solar prior, debt-free identity) into anchored, personalized selling; he runs the verify checklist reactively and nearly forgets the interest question entirely. The appointment gets booked, but on a fragile, unaddressed cost objection.
